summary: Learn to assess agricultural climate exposure and prioritise adaptation investment. Build a risk register, scorecard, and monitoring plan. Enquire today.
lede: Climate adaptation investment training for agricultural value chains helps programme and finance professionals prioritise resilience spending. Learners map hazards, exposure and vulnerability, compare farm and value-chain measures using cost and decision criteria, and build an investment scorecard. The course also covers delivery roles and monitoring indicators, supporting programme, lending and insurance decisions where data and budgets are constrained.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who allocate, structure, coordinate, or monitor adaptation investment across agricultural value chains serving smallholders.
modules: IPCC Climate Risk in Agricultural Value Chains
prerequisites: Working knowledge of agricultural programme delivery, value-chain operations, agrifinance, or adaptation planning is expected. No climate-modelling or programming experience is required. Participants should be able to work with basic spreadsheet tables; access to Excel is useful for the dashboard exercise.
